schooner.line: And he takes her to a schooner
stanza: There's a man who's been out sailing
In a decade full of dreams
And he takes her to a schooner
And he treats her like a queen
With their amber stones and green

schooner.line: And if I had a flying schooner
stanza: Well if I had a buckskin stallion
I'd tame him down and ride away
And if I had a flying schooner
I'd sail into the light of day
If I had your love forever
Sail into the light of day
